# HIIIVE

> HIIIVE (hiiive.ai) is an AI-native company builder from Berlin, founded 2024. Two engines: the Studio sells services — AI software, MVP builds, organic visibility (AI-native SEO), digital presence — delivered by forward-deployed engineers who work inside client companies. The Lab ships HIIIVE's own products (Spoky, in validation; Komplyo, in build). Every playbook the Studio sells was tested on the Lab's own products first.

Key facts:
- AI-native company builder, Berlin-Spandau, Germany. Founded 2024.
- Model: Studio (client services) × Lab (own products) — one flywheel.
- Forward-deployed engineers: they embed in the client's company, work with domain experts on real processes, results in weeks not quarters.
- MVP Build: Strategy Sprint €500 flat (5 days), fixed-price MVP build from €7,500 (~3 weeks).
- Organic visibility: AI-native SEO measured as "share of answer" across AI assistants; Visibility Sprint from €14K, Growth Retainer from €6K/month.
- Contact: hello@hiiive.ai · book a call: https://calendly.com/hiiive/dvision-potenzial
- Languages: English (default, at /) and German (at /de/...).

## Studio — services

- [MVP Build](https://hiiive.ai/studio/mvp-build): From idea to a working MVP in 3 weeks. Strategy Sprint (5 days, €500) then a fixed-price build.
- [Organic Visibility](https://hiiive.ai/studio/organic-visibility): Be the answer, not the tenth blue link — AI-native SEO measured as share of answer across assistants.
- [Digital Presence & Funnels](https://hiiive.ai/studio/digital-presence): Ownership of how the brand shows up online — measurement, fixes, funnels.
- [MVP Cost Estimator](https://hiiive.ai/tools/mvp-cost-estimator): Free interactive estimate of MVP cost and timeline, no email required.
- [Studio overview](https://hiiive.ai/studio)

## Lab — products

- Spoky — in validation.
- Komplyo — in build.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://hiiive.ai/work): Every project shipped to production and still running.
- [Mindverse — organic growth engine](https://hiiive.ai/work/mindverse-organic-engine): SEO & digital presence for Germany's GDPR-compliant AI ecosystem.
- [Wavelr — verified-PV marketplace](https://hiiive.ai/work/wavelr-pv-marketplace): MVP & SEO — marketplace for verified photovoltaic assets, concept to live in 8 weeks.
- [ahead — FIBO event game](https://hiiive.ai/work/ahead-fibo-game): Offline-first big-screen game with mobile control panel, built in 2 weeks.
